name: University of Charleston
academic_ranking: University of Charleston is a private university in Charleston, WV, offering undergraduate and graduate programs. It is regionally accredited and known for programs in health sciences, business, and pharmacy.
financial_aid: UC states it strives to offer an education that is accessible and affordable. Resources include Financial Aid, a Net Price Calculator, and Scholarships. Discounts offered for UC Alumni (20% on select graduate programs), Military/Law Enforcement, and Charleston Area Alliance members (10%); discounts cannot be combined (highest single discount applies). Source: ucwv.edu cost page, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the UC Softball Field. UC athletics venues include the Wehrle Innovation Center/Arena, UC Stadium at Laidley Field, Welch Athletic Complex, and Schoenbaum Tennis Courts. Source: ucgoldeneagles.com softball roster page, checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference. No specific rankings or recent achievements were listed on the fetched softball landing page; reputation details not publicly detailed on the pages checked (2026-07).
notes: Athletics site redirects from ucwvathletics.com to ucgoldeneagles.com. Coaching staff and roster data captured from ucgoldeneagles.com softball pages on 2026-07. Roster: 25 players plus one student manager (Olivia Chapman).
